---
title: Listings
description: Pages that list other pages, as a list, a grid of cards or a table, with categories and a feed.
order: 6
---

A page with `listing:` in its front matter lists other pages, as in Quarto. The [News](../news/index.qmd)
page is a listing, and so is the grid of the guide on the [home page](../index.qmd).

```yaml
---
title: News
listing:
  contents: posts          # a folder, or globs, from this page's folder
  type: default            # default, grid or table
  sort: "date desc"        # or a list: ["date desc", "title"]; false keeps the order found
  categories: true         # the categories in the margin: true, numbered, unnumbered or cloud
  feed: true               # an RSS feed beside the page; needs website.site-url
---
```

## What an item shows

Each item is a page. smalldocs reads its front matter:

| Field | From |
|---|---|
| `title`, `subtitle`, `author`, `date`, `categories` | The front matter |
| `description` | The front matter, or else the first paragraph of the page |
| `image` | The front matter, or else the first picture in the page |
| `reading-time`, `word-count` | Counted from the page |
| `filename`, `file-modified` | The file |

Choose and order the fields with `fields: [title, date, description]`.

## The three types

`default`
: A row for each page: the date and the author on the left, the title and the description in the
  middle, the picture on the right.

`grid`
: A card for each page, `grid-columns` across (3 by default), with the picture on top at
  `image-height`.

`table`
: A row for each page, a column for each field.

## Other options

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `id` | The listing's id. If the page has an empty div with this id, the listing goes there; else at the end |
| `max-items` | Show at most this many |
| `page-size` | Split into pages of this many; 50 by default |
| `sort-ui`, `filter-ui` | A box to sort and a box to filter; on for `default` and `table` |
| `max-description-length` | Cut a description at this many characters; 175 by default |
| `date-format` | Such as `MMMM D, YYYY`, or `iso`, `long`, `medium`, `short` |
| `include`, `exclude` | Keep or drop items by field: `include: {categories: news}` |
| `field-display-names` | The heading of a table's column |
| `grid-item-align`, `grid-item-border` | The alignment and the border of a card |
| `table-striped`, `table-hover` | The look of a table |

A category on a post links back to the listing, filtered to that category. A click on a category in a
listing filters it too.
